title: Iterating over settings.items() in transition implementation yields invalid list values

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Below is a minimal example, running `bazel-dev build --features=y //:lib_with_feature_x` on it results in `Error: unsupported binary operation: List + list`.
This object has `type(value) != type([])` and normal list operations cannot be performed on it. Trying to use it in a test with not operator even results in a java exception with `invalid Starlark value: class com.google.common.collect.SingletonImmutableList`

Both `settings["//command_line_option:features"]`  and `settings.items()[0][1]` works as expected.

=== rules.bzl ====
```
def _add_feature_x_transition_impl(settings, attrs):
    build_settings = {}
    for key, value in settings.items():
        if key == "//command_line_option:features":
            value = value + ["x"]  # <-------- FAULTY VALUE HERE
        build_settings[key] = value
    return build_settings

add_feature_x_transition = transition(
    implementation = _add_feature_x_transition_impl,
    inputs = ["//command_line_option:features"],
    outputs = ["//command_line_option:features"],
)

def _apply_feature_x_impl(ctx):
    return cc_common.merge_cc_infos(cc_infos = [dep[CcInfo] for dep in ctx.attr.deps])

apply_feature_x = rule(
    cfg = add_feature_x_transition,
    implementation = _apply_feature_x_impl,
    attrs = {
        "deps": attr.label_list(providers=[CcInfo]),
        "_whitelist_function_transition": attr.label(
            default = "@bazel_tools//tools/whitelists/function_transition_whitelist"),
    },
)
```
==== BUILD.bazel ====
```
load("@rules_cc//cc:defs.bzl", "cc_library")
load(":rules.bzl", "apply_feature_x")

cc_library(
    name = "lib",
)

apply_feature_x(
    name = "lib_with_feature_x",
    deps = [":lib"],
)
```
